description: Status, long or short
detail: The short form is one line per file: first column staged, second unstaged.

description: Stage files
Pick what to stage from a fuzzy list
detail: Tab marks several. Shows modified and untracked files, skips __pycache__.

description: Pick what to unstage
Pick which files to throw local changes away from
detail: Destructive: the files you pick go back to their committed state.

description: Diff the working tree / the staged changes
detail: gds before committing is the fastest way to catch a stray debug line.

description: Commit with a message
Commit with the editor open and the diff shown underneath
Commit without running the hooks
Fold changes into the last commit, keeping its message
detail: Amend, no edit, no hooks. Do not do this to commits you have already pushed.

description: Commit with the ticket ID pulled off the branch name
detail: On branch abc-123-add-login it writes "ABC-123: message". gqcp does the same and pushes.

description: Create a branch and switch to it
Switch branch by picking from a list
List local / remote branches
Fetch, then rebase onto what came down
detail: Keeps history flat instead of adding a merge commit.

description: Pull / push
The last ten commits as a compact graph
Find the commit that introduced or removed a piece of text
detail: The one to reach for when you want to know why a line exists.

description: Every position HEAD has been in, including ones you thought you lost
detail: The undo button after a bad reset or rebase.

description: Open LazyGit
detail: Space stages a file, Enter opens it to stage individual lines or hunks, c commits, P pushes, and the whole repo state is visible at once.

description: The keybinding help, in whichever panel is focused
detail: LazyGit has different keys per panel, so check it in context.
